# ovirt_disk (Data Source)

The ovirt_disk data source returns the ID and details of a disk by its alias or ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `alias` (String) Human-readable alias of the disk. Either alias or id must be specified.
- `id` (String) oVirt ID of the disk. Either alias or id must be specified.
- `storage_domain_id` (String) ID of the storage domain the disk belongs to. Used to filter/disambiguate disks with the same alias.

### Read-Only

- `format` (String) Format of the disk image (e.g. raw, cow).
- `size` (Number) Disk provisioned size in bytes.
- `sparse` (Boolean) Whether sparse provisioning is enabled for the disk.
- `status` (String) Status of the disk (e.g. ok, locked, etc.).
- `total_size` (Number) Size of the actual image on the disk in bytes.
